1.d4 e6 2.c4 b6 3.Nc3 Bb7 4.e4 f5 5.exf5.strategy: Takes the pawn and opens the centre. The bishop's diagonal now runs right up to g2, which the bishop on f1 guards, and White keeps its pawns on d4 and c4. If Black does not recapture, White stays a pawn up.

1.d4 e6 2.c4 b6 3.Nc3 Bb7 4.e4 f5 5.d5.strategy: Declines the pawn and answers in the centre instead: the pawn hits e6 and stands in front of the bishop on b7, which now bites on a well-guarded pawn. White keeps its space and avoids the complications of an open centre.
1.d4 e6 2.c4 b6 3.Nc3 Bb7 4.e4 f5 5.d5.name: English Defence: Hartlaub Gambit Declined

1.d4 e6 2.c4 b6 3.Nc3 Bb7 4.e4 f5 5.exf5.strategy: Leaves the pawn on f5 and develops instead, as a gambit. The knight covers h5, keeping the queen check off, and controls e4 and d5, while the open diagonal runs from the bishop to g2. Black plays for activity against an extra pawn that White may keep.
1.d4 e6 2.c4 b6 3.Nc3 Bb7 4.e4 f5 5.exf5.name: English Defence: Hartlaub Gambit Accepted
